findings.statement: REQ-VER-013 and SCN-VER-112..114 check a 'detail' (author, form, pull_request) of REF_NOT_VERIFIED/DECISION_NOT_VERIFIED, but no JSON field for it exists in the error/finding shape; DECISION_NOT_VERIFIED shape is undefined.
findings.recommendation: Name the field (e.g. reason: decision, detail: author) and the DECISION_NOT_VERIFIED finding shape {code, unknown, detail, path}.

findings.statement: 'Path no Run operation writes' is defined as outside paths.src, paths.tests, openspec/changes/**, so docs/** under an active Run (SCN-ENF-011) gets the 'human in factory-change' hint, though SCN-ENF-012 allows docs edits without a Run.
findings.recommendation: Limit the hint to policy paths (match.paths of factory-change); keep run finish/run start hint for other paths; add a docs scenario.

findings.statement: unknown add/resolve is allowed in APPROVED..VERIFYING, but REQ-VER-013 requires the decision comment in the spec-PR of APPROVED; a decision commented in the impl-PR fails with pull_request.
findings.recommendation: Define which PR may hold decisions for UNKNOWN raised after APPROVED, or forbid add after APPROVED; add a scenario.

findings.statement: Any maintainer comment in the spec-PR is accepted; its content is not tied to the UNK id, so an agent can cite an unrelated comment and lift WAIT itself.
findings.recommendation: Require the comment body to contain the UNK id, or state this as accepted residual risk.

findings.statement: A blocking UNKNOWN can be closed by the agent with --as fact|assumption without ref (SCN-VER-110 PASS), bypassing the maintainer check that ADR-0040 p.3 motivates.
findings.recommendation: Decide explicitly whether blocking UNKNOWN may be closed without DECISION and record it in spec.

findings.statement: resolve with empty --text is not covered, and 'closed' is undefined for UNKNOWN_RESOLVED; the gate treats empty resolution as open.
findings.recommendation: Empty --text/--area/--text on add -> USAGE; define closed as non-empty resolution, as the gate does.

findings.statement: FORGE_UNAVAILABLE 'as for other refs' means code 3 even in PRs without new APPROVED, where the decision check is only informational; a spec-PR may fail on it.
findings.recommendation: State whether forge failure in PRs without new APPROVED is code 3 or a finding.

findings.statement: No error is named for unknown add/resolve on a Change without a record.
findings.recommendation: Name the existing record-not-found code with hint.

findings.statement: Unclear whether resolve --as assumption also appends an ASM item to assumptions[]; proposal says ASSUMPTION is written only by closing UNKNOWN.
findings.recommendation: State that assumptions[] is not written (or how ASM id is allocated).

findings.statement: DECISION_WITHOUT_REF: 'such element' may mean blocking-only or any element; REQ-VER-013 checks only blocking.
findings.recommendation: Say explicitly whether non-blocking decisions without ref fail the gate.

findings.statement: Proposal says classify 'warns' when base is behind upstream; REQ-KRN-028 refuses with BASE_BEHIND_UPSTREAM.
findings.recommendation: Update proposal What Changes to the refusal.

findings.statement: ADR-0040 p.2 allows unknown in any non-terminal state; REQ-KRN-035 and SCN-KRN-152 reject MERGED.
findings.recommendation: Align ADR wording or spec state list.

findings.statement: Spec counts openspec/changes/archive/** as Run-writable (under openspec/changes/**); design writableByRun excludes archive/.
No scenarios for details missing (comment 404) and repository (foreign repo).
findings.recommendation: Add scenarios for missing and repository.

assumptions.statement: REF_NOT_VERIFIED 'reason' maps to an existing JSON field; only 'detail' is new.

decisions_required.question: May a blocking UNKNOWN be closed as fact/assumption without maintainer ref?
options: No, blocking requires decision with ref

decisions_required.question: Where must the decision comment live for UNKNOWN raised after APPROVED?
